x.description: tensor of shape `(*, n)` where `*` is zero or more batch dimensions consisting of vectors.
constraints: Unlike `numpy.vander`, this function returns the powers of :attr:`x` in ascending order.

N.description: Number of columns in the output. Default: `x.size(-1)`

output.description: Returns the Vandermonde matrix :math:`V` If N = None, then `N = x.size(-1)` so that the output is a square matrix.

constraints: Supports inputs of float, double, cfloat, cdouble, and integral dtypes.
The output has the same batch dimensions as the input.
